# Design approval — Phase 3

## Status

**Approved for code translation.** The cascade UI design generated by `pen --agent codex --model gpt-5.5` passes the impeccable audit with a score of 17/20.

## Approval summary

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Design file | `taxon.pen` (109 KB) |
| Generator | Pencil CLI via Codex |
| Audit score | 17/20 (Good) |
| Audit document | [`design-audit.md`](design-audit.md) |
| Components | 4 reusable (Toggle Chip, Dropdown Field, Source Link Button, Species Row) |
| Viewports | 2 (Desktop 1440, Mobile 390) |
| States covered | 8 (loading, empty, 404, 409, network, disabled, focus, active) |
| Color tokens | 9 semantic + 10 hex (badge backgrounds) |
| Typography | Inter + IBM Plex Mono (Pencil rejected system-ui) |

## Decisions

1. **Approved.** The design expresses a coherent product-specific system with reusable components and a parallel state matrix.
2. **Token extraction deferred to code.** The 10 hard-coded hex values for badge backgrounds will be replaced with Tailwind tokens during React implementation. Tracked as P2 follow-up.
3. **Typography fallback documented.** Inter + IBM Plex Mono chosen because Pencil rejected `system-ui`. The production CSS will declare `system-ui, Inter, sans-serif` so the user's OS font wins before Inter loads.
4. **Visual review deferred.** A final interactive review in `Pen.app` is recommended but not blocking. The user has the design open in `Pen.app` and can take screenshots at any time.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Design file exists (`taxon.pen`).
- [x] Design covers all 8 requirements (header, toggles, cascade, species list, breadcrumb, links, ambiguity picker, states).
- [x] Mobile + Desktop parity.
- [x] Reusable components isolated in Component Shelf.
- [x] Color tokens used for primary palette.
- [x] Audit dimensions covered (hierarchy, a11y, typography, color, integrity).
- [ ] Final visual review in Pen.app (deferred to user).
- [ ] Token extraction in React code (deferred to Phase 4).

## Next steps

Phase 4 (React + Vite + Tailwind frontend) starts now. The frontend:

- Uses the same color palette and typography as `taxon.pen`.
- Implements the cascade as a 6-step `useReducer` state machine so every transition is testable.
- Renders the 12-link grid with the same visual treatment (4×3 on desktop, 2-col on mobile).
- Uses Tailwind tokens to substitute the 10 hard-coded badge colors from the design.
- Audited with the impeccable audit command during code review.
